method: For rows unresolved by v2, only gp=1 rows on an independently inferred round date (>=10 unique links and >=75% date agreement) are considered. A link is accepted only if one unique official-valid candidate matches rounded source PDK and all 17 box-score fields. Source team is not used to select the candidate.
guardrails: Experimental dataset only; no production code/config or labels changed.
Unresolved and ambiguous candidates remain unresolved.
Missing game rows are not interpreted as DNP or OUT.
Historical outcome linkage is not a pre-lock roster/availability snapshot.
Frozen 2026/27 GW1 holdout remains untouched until 2026-10-23T12:00:00Z.
